label: Gulf Coast 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's Gulf Coast crack spread: three barrels of MEH crude producing two barrels of USGC CBOB gasoline and one barrel of USGC ULSD.

label: Mid-Continent 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's Mid-Continent crack spread: three barrels of WTI crude producing two barrels of Chicago CBOB gasoline and one barrel of Chicago ULSD.

label: West Coast 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's West Coast crack spread: three barrels of ANS crude producing two barrels of LA CARBOB and one barrel of LA CARB Diesel.

label: Blended 3-2-1 crack spread
definition: MPC's blended crack spread: the Gulf Coast, Mid-Continent and West Coast crack spreads, weighted by MPC's refining capacity by region in each period.

label: NYMEX 3:2:1 crack spread
definition: The exchange-traded crack spread: three NYMEX WTI crude oil futures against two RBOB gasoline futures and one NY Harbor ULSD futures. Not one of MPC's benchmarks.
